payload.blocks: The main checkout still has the old layout; the supervisor's head restarts with the new grants, and every other land, wait on it.
payload.headline: Run `fgos git recover`: the portfolio move is pushed (349060733) but the main checkout was not advanced

parts.cause: The git write-ahead journal record of the publish step exceeded its byte bound (the move touches about 600 files), so the land could not record the publish and left the checkout behind the pushed commit.

options.does: The owner (or the supervisor, if granted) runs `fgos git recover` in the main checkout; it reconciles the journal and advances main to 349060733.
options.gain: The checkout matches the pushed move; head restarts can follow.
options.harm: None expected; recover is the door the refusal names.
options.label: Run fgos git recover (recommended)

options.cost: A force-push or revert plus a new freeze.
options.does: Undo 349060733 on the remote and retry later.
options.harm: Loses the frozen-window move; needs another freeze.
options.label: Revert the push

parts.recommendation: Run `fgos git recover` now; then the supervisor restarts the heads with the new grants. A journal record that cannot hold a ~600-file land is a git-component defect worth a backlog row.

scope.allows: Running fgos git recover once in the main checkout.

parts.what: fgos land work-data-model/p05i failed at publish with git-wal-corrupt ('record byte bound; the push or publish may have happened: run fgos git recover'). origin/main is 349060733 'land work-data-model/p05i' (the move: 453 items, 51 discussions, grant swap, drift baseline), but local main is still 14ff2bc74 and docs/discussions is still on disk in the main checkout.
